collection.title: Vauxhall Vivaro 2000 to 2001 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Vivaro 2000 to 2001 model requires a 24" wiper blade for the drivers and a 21" on the passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper.
